calls.head: Patience vs. Spray-and-pray
calls.body: The Penguins wait for good looks, but the Jets settle for hopeful ones. Pittsburgh is near the top of the league for shot quality, and Winnipeg is one of the worst. The more dangerous chances should be the Penguins’.

surprises.head: Winnipeg shut down Pittsburgh’s power play
surprises.body: Pittsburgh’s power play created 1.9 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.8 and a league average of 7.6. A team strays this far about once every 25 games.

story.head: The Jets get past the Penguins
paras: The Penguins’ Sergei Murashov was back in an NHL net for the first time since Dec 14, 2025. Ben Kindel got the scoring started for the Pens midway through the second. The third period was a wild one. Alex Iafallo and Adam Lowry scored two and a half minutes apart early in the period to turn a 1-0 deficit into a 2-1 lead. Declan Carlile tied it up for Pittsburgh less than two minutes later, and Cole Perfetti put the Jets ahead for good just nine seconds later.

The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. Clay Stevenson made 29 saves for the Jets. The Jets improved to 2-0-1, climbing into first in the Central. The Penguins dropped to 2-1-0, slipping out of first in the NHL.
